ui_bugs.issue: A contracts.create event with attempt 2 (tentativa 2) showing all three vendor badges with ✓ 200 (success) still renders a 'partial failure' sub-label in red. The badge appears to reflect historical attempt state rather than current state — slightly misleading. Cosmetic only.

action_items: (LOW) Consider hiding 'partial failure' label on outbox events whose latest attempt fully succeeded (all vendors ok). Today the label sticks once any prior attempt failed even if a retry/redelivery brought everything to OK.
critical_code_review_comments: ERP worker correctly defaults all 3 connector endpoints to http://localhost:8001/api/integrations/_simulator/{vendor} via INTERNAL_BASE_URL fallback — no external dependency for preview/dev.

Topics correctly partitioned: SAP=(clients.*, contracts.*, orders.*), Oracle=(contracts.*, orders.*), Siagri=(clients.*, contracts.*, orders.*, cargas.*). Verified Oracle does NOT receive clients.* deliveries.

Siagri transform produces full pt-BR field schema (entidade, codigoExterno, cpfCnpj, regiao, culturas, areaHectares, tier, ContratoGraos.tipo Venda/Compra/Barter, etc.) — well modelled for Brazilian agro ERP.
Outbox MongoDB collection (outbox_events) plus deliveries collection (connector_deliveries) provide full audit trail. _id is excluded via projection {'_id': 0} — good.
Retry endpoint allows resetting both 'failed' and 'delivered' events to 'pending' — useful for replay; ensure idempotency on consumer side is documented (current connectors are at-least-once).

Simulator endpoint /_simulator/{vendor} is intentionally public (no current_user dependency) — comment in code clarifies this is by design so connectors can call it without auth handshake. Acceptable.
